1) the MC algorithm in IPLAN agrees well with the PB algorithm within 5% in dose coverage for prostate, brain and paraspinal plans, 2) MC algorithm in IPLANDisagree significantly (upto 30%) with the PB algorithm for lung plans and 3) MC algorithm in IPALN requires higher MUs (upto 20%) for maintaining similar dose coverage in lung compared to PB algorithm.
the calculated dose by Monte Carlo and Pencil Beam agrees within 5 percent for prostate, brain and head and neck tumors, but not for paraspinal tumors and lung tumors.
the calculated dose by MC agrees within 5 percent with the dose calculated by the pencil beam algorithm for prostate, brain and paraspinal and 5 percent for head and neck tumors.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
MC is more suitable for lung and IMRT plans, while PB can be used for prostate and other tumors.

PB algorithm can be used to plan lung tumors and for dose calculations of the prostate, brain, paraspinal tumors, head and neck tumors.

MC dose calculations should be used with caution in lung tumors.
